content.short: Yearn Smart Contracts are the Solidity and Vyper contracts behind the Yearn Vault.
content.description: Yearn Smart Contracts houses the Solidity and Vyper contracts that implement the underlying logic for the Yearn Vaults. Developers can explore the requirements, test scripts, contracts, and the standards used to execute high-risk business logic, including guidance on security, testing, and deployment practices. The project benefits from more than 700 forks, numerous contributors and stars, and a community of over 200,000, helping keep the Vaults active, reliable, and widely used.
